title: Subscription-Only Auto Run CEO — AUDIT_R3 minimal auth-mode closure: codexAuthMode honors persisted auth_mode precedence and rejects contradictory credential families
description: AUDIT_R3 minimal closure on the opt-in subscription-only autonomous lane (PAIR_OBJECTIVE_AUTO_DRIVER=1, still default OFF). R3-F1: codexAuthMode() in codex-cli-transport.ts now matches codex-rs' persisted-mode precedence — an explicit auth_mode field wins over credential-shape inference: auth_mode 'chatgpt' resolves CHATGPT only with valid OAuth token material; 'apikey' resolves API_KEY and any other explicit value resolves AMBIGUOUS, all denied regardless of coexisting tokens; a non-string/empty auth_mode is unverifiable → AMBIGUOUS. When auth_mode is absent, credential inference uses codex-rs AuthDotJson::resolved_mode() Option::is_some() semantics — field PRESENCE with a non-null value is a persisted credential: OPENAI_API_KEY (any non-null value, including an empty string) resolves API_KEY, and personal_access_token / bedrock_api_key / bedrock_access_keys (any non-null value, including empty strings/arrays/objects) resolve AMBIGUOUS — never CHATGPT merely because OAuth tokens coexist. Token-shape verification, fail-closed absent/malformed handling and manual Executor behavior unchanged; no credential values are read, logged or persisted. The single resolver feeds all three enforcement seams unchanged — CodexCliExecutorAdapter spawn boundary (FAIL_CLOSED_CODEX_AUTH_MODE), driver admission + authorityGate re-proof (DRIVER_SUBSCRIPTION_UNVERIFIED), and the atomic assertAndReserve gate (FAIL_CLOSED_COST_AUTONOMOUS_AUTH_MODE). Evidence: 63 focused tests (Z10.1-11: chatgpt/tokens ok, chatgpt-mode ok, apikey-mode denied, non-chatgpt mode denied, PAT denied, bedrock families denied, chatgpt-mode-without-tokens denied, admission-level apikey denial, empty-string/empty-collection credential presence denied, null fields absent) failing-first pre-implementation; all R2 Z9 coverage preserved; win32 baselines unchanged (10d=15, 10d-r1=7, met-fold=7, p15-3=9, cpl1=22, p5=3).
